summary: Block 8: finished the bounded definition/quantifier audit of the FullApprox.agrees interface (FULLAPPROX-AGREES-AUDIT.md sections 6.1-6.4). Definition level: thresholdMap c eps alpha q i = max(diskAverage-alpha,0)/sum_k max(diskAverage_k-alpha,0) is exactly the paper's q^eps_i(z) (7.4, p.44 l.2340-2346); the supporting lemmas match the paper's three claims one for one (thresholdTotal_pos = denominator positivity at alpha<1/5; thresholdMap_sum + thresholdMap_nonneg = 'continuous map into the simplex'; thresholdMap_pos = 'q_i>0 iff pi_i>alpha'); and 'G = one-skeleton' corresponds exactly to graphRealization of the complete graph, i.e. 'at most two positive coordinates' - which is the content of Lemma 7.3, carried in the tree by the codomain type GraphSpace. ONE sub-link left open and named: diskLaw eps must be the normalised uniform law on B(0,eps); I did not read diskLaw's definition. Quantifier level: paper Lemma 7.4 quantifies exists eps_n decreasing, exists H_n, then FOR EVENTUALLY ALL n; the Lean statement is for every t>0, Nonempty (FullApprox c alpha t) - one scale per budget, no eventual quantifier. The two are interchangeable: paper=>Lean is a cofinality argument ('eps_n -> 0, so eps_n < t for some n in the eventual set', no diagonal, no choice); Lean=>paper is countable choice with t_n = min(1/16,1/(n+1)), instantiated in the tree at Five.lean:105-113 and consumed by no_large_positive_sequence. Single recorded loss: the Lean form gives no MONOTONE decreasing eps_n; monotonicity is used nowhere in s7.2-7.4 and cannot be restored for free. Non-quantifier instance differences recorded: square Q/Q' versus closedBall 0 5/7/8. Nothing here is a gap; the bodies of small_hole_map, holeApprox_exists, eventually_fill_cores stay graded proved-in-tree-unaudited. hasNbr_image repair received by the supervisor as structurally correct, retry pending, not marked passed. No builds, no computation this block.

Reading the drop-one runs as evidence of individual necessity: that is the reverse implication and is not established by them.

Expecting the mesh/diameter bound to be the §7 gap: the Lean splits it into a dichotomy inside Five.lean, so it is not a hypothesis left open.

My first block-6 check script applied the identity map instead of h and reported all identities false - a script bug, not a mathematical finding; corrected and re-run inside the same one-process budget.

`refine ⟨membership-proof, ?_⟩` for a `Finset.Nonempty` goal: Nonempty is `∃ a, a ∈ s`, so the witness must come first; the local run caught this at hasNbr_image and it also poisoned neighbour_family_push with sorryAx.

Restoring the paper's monotone eps_n from the Lean per-scale form: monotonicity cannot be obtained by replacing eps_n with min over k<=n, because shrinking eps changes pi^eps and hence the entire disk family and the agreement map; it would need the construction to be redone at the new scale. Recorded as the single loss of the interchange.

escalation.obstacle: (NC-1), restated precisely: at an accumulation point x of a specified five-cycle locus, with a = lim h_n/|h_n| and R the rotation acting on directions, the list S(R a) = {i : R a lies in the closed essential support of state i at x} has no common label, i.e. the intersection of the diagonals D_i over i in S(R a) is empty.
